data.title: Ocean Cove
data.about:
Discover the tranquil beauty of Ocean Cove at Rashid Yachts & Marina, where nature and urban life harmoniously blend to create an enchanting environment. The Emaar Ocean Cove project in Dubai features architecture that embodies Dubai's innovative spirit, combining classic elegance with modern design. Utilizing premium, nature-inspired materials, it captures the city's architectural progress while enhancing cultural richness. The one-bedroom Ocean Cove apartments are ideal for singles or couples, featuring roomy layouts, open kitchens, and private balconies. The larger two- and three-bedroom units boast en-suite bathrooms, generous wardrobe space, and spacious balconies.

Located in the heart of Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Cove by Emaar offers an elegant lifestyle that merges the serene charm of a high-end waterfront community with the dynamic, diverse energy of Dubai. It’s a sanctuary where luxury and comfort coexist, set against the serene backdrop of lush greenery. Explore the seashore serenity at Ocean Cove Emaar Dubai, and benefit from the convenient amenities including a clinic right next to the property and a school just a short stroll away. Discover more about the Emaar Ocean Cove location, the comprehensive Ocean Cove Emaar master plan, and the attractive Ocean Cove Emaar payment plan. For detailed information, refer to the Ocean Cove brochure and floor plan below.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Refined Living at Emaar Ocean Cove
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Premier residences thoughtfully designed with elegance and style.
  • Clinic ideally situated next to the property and a school just steps away.
  • Moments away from beautiful dining, retail, shopping, cultural, and leisure experiences.
  • Offers masterfully detailed and expansive 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom Ocean Cove apartments.
  • Boasts a cutting-edge platform offering a variety of world-class amenities.
  • Designed to be a contemporary residential oasis that offers tranquil surroundings and exciting nearby attractions.
  • Located in the prestigious Rashid Yachts & Marina community.
  • Experience seashore serenity at Ocean Cove Emaar Dubai.
  • Part of the Emaar Ocean Cove project in Dubai, reflecting the city's architectural evolution.

location_tile.title: Live Perfectly Connected at Rashid Yachts & Marina
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Ocean Cove at Rashid Yachts & Marina is ideally located to harmonize with nature while providing urban convenience. Living at Emaar Ocean Cove means Dubai's landmarks are just an extension of your home. Embrace the city's rich heritage, the tranquility of waterfront living, and the close proximity to bustling business districts.

Situated in one of Dubai's oldest neighborhoods, Ocean Cove by Emaar offers daily inspiration with several nearby cultural institutions, including a theatre, a museum, and the former residence of Sheikh Saeed Al Maktoum. Discover the perfect blend of historical charm and modern living at Emaar Ocean Cove at Rashid Yachts & Marina in Dubai.

  • 10 minutes to Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 20 minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 22 minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 20 minutes to the Dubai Mall/Burj Khalifa
  • 20 minutes to Dubai Creek Harbour

more_info.answer: Emaar Ocean Cove at Rashid Yachts and Marina is a luxury residential development offering modern 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments. It combines contemporary architectural finesse with panoramic marina views, providing a unique lifestyle experience in Dubai.
more_info.question: What is Emaar Ocean Cove at Rashid Yachts and Marina?

more_info.answer: Emaar Ocean Cove is ideally located to harmonize with nature while offering urban convenience. It provides seamless access to Dubai's landmarks, rich heritage, and bustling business districts, making it a desirable place for luxury waterfront living.
more_info.question: What makes Emaar Ocean Cove a desirable place to live?

more_info.answer:
The apartment sizes and starting prices at Emaar Ocean Cove are:

1 Bedroom Apartments: 786 - 844 sq. ft., starting at AED 1.76 million
2 Bedroom Apartments: 1,152 - 1,417 sq. ft., starting at AED 2.50 million
3 Bedroom Apartments: 1,649 - 1,853 sq. ft., starting at AED 3.44 million
more_info.question: What are the apartment sizes and starting prices at Emaar Ocean Cove?

more_info.answer: Emaar Ocean Cove offers a range of world-class amenities, including a community park, gym, swimming pool, boardwalk promenade, sports court, retail and dining options, and both indoor and outdoor gyms.
more_info.question: What amenities are available at Emaar Ocean Cove?

more_info.answer: Emaar Ocean Cove is located in the prestigious Rashid Yachts and Marina community, Port Rashid, Dubai. It is conveniently situated within minutes of Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai International Airport, providing easy access to major destinations.
more_info.question: Where is Emaar Ocean Cove located?

more_info.answer: The payment plan for Emaar Ocean Cove includes a 10% booking fee, 70% during construction, and 20% upon completion, offering a flexible and structured payment approach.
more_info.question: What payment plan options are available for Emaar Ocean Cove?

more_info.answer: The completion date for Emaar Ocean Cove is set for October 2028.
more_info.question: When will Emaar Ocean Cove be completed?

more_info.answer: Emaar Ocean Cove is developed by Emaar Properties, a renowned developer known for high-quality, innovative real estate projects such as Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall.
more_info.question: Who developed Emaar Ocean Cove?

more_info.answer: Residents of Emaar Ocean Cove can access several cultural and leisure attractions, including a theatre, a museum, and the former residence of Sheikh Saeed Al Maktoum. The community also offers upscale dining, retail experiences, and serene waterfront living.
